data_fields.name: texture_slots
data_fields.donor_constant: driver GL_MAX_TEXTURE_IMAGE_UNITS, halved on compile failure

best_idea: Keep a small table of texture slots and write each sprite's slot index into its vertices, so one draw covers sprites from several textures, flushing only when the buffer is full or a new texture needs a slot still in use.
decision_why: A HUD that draws icons, bars, numbers and a font per frame gains from one draw per batch; the donor's run-based counting, doc mismatch and missing aging are fixed in the sketch, and the HUD should use one atlas so evictions are rare.
acceptance: A unit test on the HUD batch draws a 40-sprite frame using six textures with at least eight slots in at most two draw calls; with more textures than slots, an evicted texture is bound again at its next draw; at 375 wide the frame log shows the HUD draw count per frame.
